blurb: Guests can taste wines from California and France at the Downingtown tasting room, attend guided tastings, and participate in special events such as live music and wine club parties. The tasting room also hosts private events for up to 75 guests. The wines focus on Rhône varietals and are produced by winemaker Kieran Robinson, who has experience in California and France.
